name: grail
description: Grail language support: syntax highlighting, and the Grail language server (diagnostics and go to definition).

grail.server.path.markdownDescription: Program that starts the Grail language server on stdio. The default runs `grail.server.args`, which is `tools/lsp.mjs` in the workspace: the launcher `docs/tooling/lsp.md` documents (`bun tools/lsp.mjs`). Set this to `grail` (with `grail.server.args` `["lsp"]`) when your Grail installation ships a `grail lsp` subcommand, or to any executable that speaks the language server protocol on stdio.

grail.server.cwd.markdownDescription: Working directory for the server process. Empty means the first workspace folder, which is where `tools/lsp.mjs` lives in a Grail checkout.
